## Summary

Describe the change and its user/math impact.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Math changes include transparent fixtures and updated documentation
- [ ] Source IDs, headers, units, and configuration versions are preserved or intentionally migrated
- [ ] No payout logic was added to UI/presentation code
- [ ] No secrets, dependencies, build output, or bulk reports are committed
- [ ] The change remains simulated-credit only and respects `docs/responsible-design.md`

## Evidence and unresolved decisions

Include commands, seed/configuration IDs, screenshots when useful, and remaining assumptions.
